issues.description: Method 'getTotalNumberOfStudents()' visibility mismatch: the problem statement's UML declares the method as public (+getTotalNumberOfStudents(): int) (problem_statement.md line 70), while the solution implementation declares it as protected ('protected int getTotalNumberOfStudents()') (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java line 75). This inconsistency can confuse students about the intended accessibility and may cause external code or automated tests that expect a public method to fail to call it.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the visibility consistent. Preferred fix: change the implementation to public by updating the solution (and template) signature to 'public int getTotalNumberOfStudents()' so it matches the UML and is accessible to tests and external code. Alternatively, if protected was intended, update the UML and problem text to show the method as protected and explain the reason to students.
